reviews.text:
I've been buying products for my dog ​​Oscar at this shop for a while now, and I couldn't be happier. The owners are wonderful; they always greet you with a smile and offer a friendly, personal, and above all, very humane service. You can tell they do their job with love and genuinely care about their customers.

It's such a pleasure to find businesses like this, where it's not just what you buy that matters, but also how they make you feel. Oscar and I are thrilled! ❤️🐾 Highly recommended!

Thank you so much for your 5 stars, Cristina! ⭐🐾 We're so glad to hear you had a positive experience at Pet Home and that you took the time to leave us your review. ❤️ We hope to see you again very soon! 😊 …
Highly recommended!! I always buy everything for my kitten here.
Super pet store! We buy food, treats, toys, and even get our pet bathed there! The best part is the service! Our go-to store for our furry friend.

I discovered Pethome over a year ago, and it's one of those places I love going to every time. My dog ​​always leaves the groomer looking gorgeous and happy, and they treat her with so much love. The shop is spotless, they have everything you need, and they always know how to give great advice. Without a doubt, our go-to place 🤍 …

A very complete pet shop, plus a top-notch grooming salon. They have everything: food from many brands, toys, accessories, coats, hygiene products, and good value for money. The staff are very friendly and always give your pet a treat. They've also recently renovated the shop and it looks fantastic. Super long opening hours, non-stop during the week and until midday on Saturdays. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!
Excellent service, high-quality products at a good price. Highly recommended.

I want to highlight the friendly, cheerful (and always smiling) service from one of your employees. This is my second time at the store, and she has always been particularly attentive.

There aren't many places where you feel so welcome. I'd love to know that this employee feels valued at her job because her service is so exceptional.

PetHome 👏👏👏
